description: Reserved - Elections Commission - Declare that W. M. M. S. Marikkar as a member of the Pathahewaheta Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government authority (Pathahewaheta Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of an elected member, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of elected members for local government bodies, which falls under the Elections classification type.
